data.why: The web UI has no upload feature; it browses a prebuilt SQLite wordnet database, so build_test_db.py runs the repo's own MergeBuilder over its bundled test fixtures (tests/wordnets/wn-en.xml, wn-fr.xml) to produce web/cygnet.db.gz and web/provenance.db.gz (filenames already referenced by web/local.json), avoiding the ~89MB GitHub release download or the ~700MB full build.sh source fetch.

goals: Look up a lemma (e.g. 'dog') and see its senses, definitions, and translations across languages
Use a glob pattern (e.g. 'dog*' or '*ness') to find related word forms
Look up a concept directly by its Interlingual Index id (e.g. 'i3' or 'cili.i3')
Search glosses by content (e.g. 'def:animal') to find concepts matching a definition
Filter search results to a single language and compare how a concept is lexicalized across languages
Inspect a concept's hypernym/hyponym relations and provenance (which source wordnet contributed each record)

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose closely: search a merged multilingual wordnet by word, pattern, cross-language ID or definition text, then compare how each language expresses a concept and trace each record to its source. Its phases are the right size, the labels are clean, and every screen I opened shows what its node says. It needs small fixes before filing: drop the 'no results' task, split the oversized settings feature, and note the missing sense view and Graph view.
